# FEMIC GNN Instance

> Agent-facing index for the GNN prototype. Read the linked pages before you change the model or its public outputs.

## Start here

- [Home](index.html): model status, caveats, and the derived benchmark at a glance.
- [Benchmark](benchmark.html): opening-first result and ground-plot validation limits.
- [Model build](model-build.html): the combined TSA 46/47 build method and commands, plus the optional P9 indicator path.
- [Terrain/VRI/LiDAR indicators](indicators.html): what is model-wide, what is a bounded pilot, validation results, and the no-model-semantics rule.
- [AU structure](aus.html): why TSA-prefixed AUs are kept and why a reporting crosswalk is used.
- [AOI](aoi.html): proposed GNN Statement of Intent boundary provenance and areas.
- [Boundary review](review.html): review status, questions, and the no-confirmation rule.
- [Release notes](release.html): the prototype release, known gaps, and caveats.
- [Economic screening](economic-screening.html): full-THLB diagnostic net revenue screen and limits.
- [Cost and revenue contract](cost-revenue-contract.html): the per-block cost, grade/sort, price, and net revenue schema.
- [API reference](api/index.html): workflow validator and dashboard entry points.

## Status

The model is a volume-only prototype. The boundary is proposed; the THLB and AAC
are derived and non-legal. A P3 diagnostic screen and P9 descriptive indicators
exist, but there is no validated operability, cost, or net revenue model in the
release. It is not a sustainable harvest level. GNN review is required before
public or operational use.

P9 fields are not model-wide LiDAR: the LiDAR pilot covers 181 direct fragments /
184 blocks / 978.63 ha, and the 30 m Terrarium/VRI proxies are descriptive only.
Do not use them for operability thresholds or CHM claims.
